headline: OpenAI brings GPT-Live full-duplex voice to Codex and ChatGPT desktop apps
summary: Developers can now control coding tasks, debug, and review pull requests using natural voice commands, enabling a new era of hands-free software development.
details: OpenAI has integrated its GPT-Live full-duplex voice model into the ChatGPT desktop applications for macOS and Windows. This allows developers to interact with agentic systems like Codex and ChatGPT Work using simultaneous listening and speaking capabilities, eliminating rigid turn-taking.

This new voice control expands conversational AI into technical workflows, enabling software engineers to orchestrate multi-threaded coding jobs, review pull requests, and debug applications using natural voice commands. This could usher in an era of "hands free" software development for Codex's over 5 million weekly active users.

The integration allows for real-time voice analysis of the frontmost window, local files, codebase structures, and active plugins on macOS. This creates a pair-programming dynamic where developers can talk through problems conversationally while AI agents execute tasks asynchronously.

Developers can initiate multiple concurrent task threads from a single spoken prompt, such as investigating a bug, reviewing a pull request, and generating unit tests simultaneously. The system can coordinate actions across Slack, GitHub, and local codebases, and even convert design mockups into code.

The voice-enabled desktop release is available to paid subscribers across Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education plans. Tasks initiated via ChatGPT Voice consume standard usage allocations from existing Codex and ChatGPT Work plan quotas.

headline_marked: Anthropic's Claude Opus/Sonnet [[Get Voice Mode]], Open-Weight Models Save 2/3 Cost
headline: Anthropic's Claude Opus/Sonnet Get Voice Mode, Open-Weight Models Save 2/3 Cost
summary: Anthropic's advanced Claude models now support voice, while a new project shows open-weight AI can match top-tier results at a third of the price.
details: Anthropic has expanded its voice mode feature to its more powerful Claude Opus and Sonnet models, previously exclusive to the Haiku model. This allows developers to integrate advanced multimodal conversational AI into applications, enabling real-time voice interactions with greater intelligence and nuance.

This update significantly broadens the potential for developers to create more natural and intuitive user experiences across various domains, from customer service and education to interactive creative assistants. Seamless voice interaction is now possible without sacrificing the underlying intelligence of the AI model.
A new 'Show HN: Echo' project demonstrates achieving high-quality AI results, comparable to models like Fable, at a significantly reduced operational cost – specifically, 1/3 of the expense.

This project highlights the strategic use of open-weight models, suggesting that through optimized fine-tuning and efficient inference, developers can achieve competitive performance without the prohibitive costs associated with proprietary commercial models.

A critical security vulnerability dubbed 'GitLost' exposes how indirect prompt injection can leak private repository data through GitHub's AI Agent. This exploit manipulates AI agents by embedding malicious content in data they process, leading to inadvertent disclosure of sensitive information.

This incident underscores a critical security challenge for AI-powered developer tools: ensuring the integrity and security of the data processed by these agents to prevent unauthorized access or leakage of private repository information.
